description: Integration with packages/api-core/discovery for automatic event emission and local policy enforcement

requirements.title: EmittingResolver decorator
requirements.description: Wraps discovery.Resolver, emits discovery events via fire-and-forget.

requirements.title: Resolver wrapping and delegation
requirements.description: EmittingResolver delegates all resolve calls to inner resolver and captures results

requirements.title: Non-blocking emission on resolve
requirements.description: Event emission MUST NOT block or add latency to the resolve call

requirements.title: Resolve event payload
requirements.description: Event includes source_scenario, target_scenario, port_key, resolved_port, duration_ms

requirements.title: Fire-and-forget event emission
requirements.description: Events sent via 256-capacity buffered channel with batching.

requirements.title: Buffered channel with drop on full
requirements.description: 256-capacity channel; events dropped with warning counter if full

requirements.title: Batch size flush
requirements.description: Background goroutine batches up to 10 events before flushing

requirements.title: Timer-based flush
requirements.description: Events flushed after 100ms if batch not full

requirements.title: Sender-side policy cache
requirements.description: Local policy cache loaded at construction and kept current via SSE.

requirements.title: Receiver-side policy middleware
requirements.description: Go middleware evaluating policy on incoming requests.

requirements.title: Graceful degradation
requirements.description: Empty cache fail-open when vrooli-events unreachable.

requirements.title: Empty cache fail-open initialization
requirements.description: Resolver starts with empty policy cache in fail-open mode when unreachable

requirements.title: Last-known policy retention on SSE drop
requirements.description: Last-known policy remains in effect until reconnection

requirements.title: SSE reconnection with exponential backoff
requirements.description: Reconnection uses 1s, 2s, 4s, max 30s backoff

requirements.title: X-Source-Scenario header injection
requirements.description: Adds X-Source-Scenario header to all outgoing HTTP requests.

requirements.title: Zero-dependency fallback
requirements.description: Existing discovery.Resolver works unchanged without vrooli-events.

requirements.title: Goroutine isolation for emission
requirements.description: Event emission runs in separate goroutine to prevent blocking resolve path

requirements.title: Nanosecond duration measurement
requirements.description: Duration measured with monotonic clock for accurate latency reporting

requirements.title: Batch size threshold trigger
requirements.description: Flush triggers when batch reaches 10 events before timer expires

requirements.title: Timer reset on flush
requirements.description: 100ms timer resets after each flush to prevent stale partial batches

requirements.title: Initial policy load at startup
requirements.description: Fetches full policy set from API on resolver construction

requirements.title: Startup validation of cached policies
requirements.description: Validates loaded policy format and logs warning on parse errors

requirements.title: SSE-driven cache updates
requirements.description: Subscribes to policy SSE channel and applies incremental updates to cache

requirements.title: Source scenario header extraction
requirements.description: Extracts X-Source-Scenario from incoming request headers for policy evaluation

requirements.title: Missing header default behavior
requirements.description: Requests without X-Source-Scenario treated as unknown source in policy eval

requirements.title: Policy decision enforcement
requirements.description: Blocks denied requests with 403 status and structured error response

requirements.title: Staleness detection via SSE keepalive
requirements.description: Detects policy cache staleness when SSE heartbeats stop arriving

requirements.title: Maximum backoff cap at 30 seconds
requirements.description: Exponential backoff capped at 30s to ensure timely reconnection

requirements.title: Header value from scenario identity
requirements.description: Resolves source scenario name from process context or configuration

requirements.title: Scenario name resolution order
requirements.description: Checks SCENARIO_NAME env var, then service.json name field, then process name

requirements.title: HTTP client request interception
requirements.description: Injects header into all outgoing HTTP requests via transport wrapper

requirements.title: Feature detection for vrooli-events
requirements.description: Checks if vrooli-events is reachable before enabling emission features

requirements.title: Graceful feature toggle
requirements.description: Silently disables emission when unreachable, re-enables when available

requirements.title: Transparent passthrough mode
requirements.description: Resolver passes through to inner resolver without modification when disabled
